title: Slingshot - AI Game Jam entry
author: ElectionImpossible54
selftext:
My cant-stop-now-jam submission. I've love to hear your feedback, this is my first AI game jam and first published AI game, Thanks for checking it out. Improvements are being added as we speak. Please leave any good ideas here and I'll consider them. Thanks.

  
Created using Claude code: Fable and Opus.



A link to my game is here: [https://w.run/retroorbit8035/slingshot](https://w.run/retroorbit8035/slingshot)

A link to the game jam is here: [https://events.run.world/events/cant-stop-now/](https://events.run.world/events/cant-stop-now/)

comments.author: Old_Swan8945
comments.body:
I think it would benefit a lot from tutorial. My assumption is that you are supposed to fly into different objects to gain fuel but it wasn't clear to me that that was the case. I wasn't able to figure out how to do that with the controls I had. 

I do think the graphics are quite pretty and I really like the purple sky.

replies.author: ElectionImpossible54
replies.body:
Thanks for your input. I'll add a tutorial next. 😀 

Additional fuel capacity can be purchased from the shop and fuel is also refilled if your ship happens to shoot down one of the enemies.

replies.author: Old_Swan8945
replies.body: Thanks, that wasn’t clear to me when I played. Seems the game is richer than I thought based on my experience of the first 1 minute of play.

replies.author: ElectionImpossible54
replies.body: The tutorial is live, give it another shot? :)

comments.author: Vivid_Gas_5755
comments.body: Our table has a running bit where the wizard's player chucks dice at the DM screen every time he rolls badly, so I opened this half expecting to be annoyed by it and then lost about twenty minutes overshooting everything by a mile. Then I hit the one where you have to bank off the side wall and just stalled out. The drag kept wanting a flatter angle than my thumb was giving it, and after a dozen tries I closed the tab still stuck on that level. In fairness I'm the guy who rolled a nat 1 shooting a stationary door from ten feet, so aiming has never been my department. Good way to lose a lunch break.

comments.author: ElectionImpossible54
comments.body: Large update including multiple levels and a tutorial! Check it out please. <3
